proposal.description: A Studionet interface test of fresh consent and scheduled public-source check-ins. This is not a real-world work, identity or investment claim.
proposal.rules: For each round of this sandbox public-page verification test, pass only if the participant statement confirms that https://example.com has the heading Example Domain and says the domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission, and the fetched public page supports both facts. Fail for a clear contradiction; otherwise return unclear. This is a technical source-content test, not independent verification of a real person or real-world work. The same two public-page facts are checked in each scheduled round.
proposal.timing: Stored creation timestamp determines the join deadline, round boundaries and terms hash only after a successful finalized creation; none exist for this unsigned draft
